title: Match entry (doors)
one_line: Doors close, board loads, doors open. Used here and nowhere else - that restraint is what makes it special.

anatomy.spec: The two brown NX doors slide together from the sides, 350 ms ease-in (tokens.json motion.doors).
Board and match state load fully behind the closed doors. Never open the doors on a half-loaded board.
Doors slide apart, 450 ms ease-out, revealing the loaded match-hud underneath.

states: Fast load - a minimum hold time behind closed doors (about 500 ms) so the transition never feels like a flicker.
Slow load - the doors stay closed with no spinner needed; if loading exceeds ~4s, show a subtle loading die inside the door seam.
motion: These timings belong ONLY to match entry - never reuse the doors elsewhere (bible 8.2).
data: Match state fully constructed before the open animation starts.
do_not: Do not reuse the doors transition for any other screen.
Do not open the doors before the board is ready.
Do not skip the minimum hold time on a fast load.
acceptance: Doors never open on an incomplete board.
A slow load shows a subtle loading cue, not a frozen closed door.
steps: 3. Add the minimum hold and the slow-load cue.
4. Confirm the board is fully loaded before the open animation fires.
5. Capture close, held and open. Postflight.
prompt:
Polish the Ludo NX match-entry doors transition.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 8.2, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json (motion.doors: close 350 ms, open 450 ms).

The art already exists and is high-res. Confirm: the doors never open before the match state is fully loaded behind them; there is a minimum hold time (~500 ms) so a fast load never flickers; and a slow load (over ~4s) shows a subtle loading cue in the door seam rather than a frozen closed door. This transition is used only for match entry - never reuse it elsewhere.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
